data.name: Vakeel
data.gender_notes: Vakeel is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Someone who is well-versed in a subject or law. A lawyer, a sage, a scholar, or someone who has acquired knowledge through study and practice. The name Vakeel carries the meaning “Learned, Scholar, Lawyer” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Vakeel usually hope their child will grow to embody learned, scholar, lawyer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, as well as the desire to help others through the application of this knowledge.
data.etymology: Vakeel belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Learned, Scholar, Lawyer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vakeel total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vakeel holds significant cultural importance in India, particularly in the legal profession, as it translates to 'lawyer'. The term 'Vakeel' has its origins in Islamic law, originating from the Arabic word 'Wakil', which means 'representative' or 'agent'. It became a part of the Indian legal system with the influence of Islamic and Persian legal practices.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Vakeel signifies someone who acts as an intercessor between the divine and human realms. The term 'Vakeel' can be interpreted as one who pleads on behalf of others before the divine, much like a lawyer argues cases on behalf of their clients.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Vakeel in Hinduism denotes one who acts as an advocate or legal counselor. Symbolically, it represents the pursuit of justice and protection of the truth, reflecting the inner desire to uphold moral values and ethics.
